content:
{
  "phoneNote": "The prominent practice photo and readable typography work well, but the location is buried near the bottom and opening hours are presented twice.",
  "desktopNote": "The hero feels calm and credible, but oversized section padding and a half-empty team section make the page unnecessarily sparse.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 4,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Add a compact location line beside the hero introduction so visitors see what the practice is, where it is and how to contact it immediately.",
    "Reduce desktop section padding, especially around the opening hours and team, and distribute the two team profiles across the available width.",
    "Keep one opening-hours presentation on phone and remove the duplicate footer schedule; retain one clear booking action rather than repeating call links throughout."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone: the opening-hours schedule is repeated in both “Kdaj vas sprejmemo” and the footer’s “Delovni čas” block."
  ]
}
